info.title: Lost and Found API
info.description:
API reference for 23 collection operations: Posts, Users, Claims, and Messages. The post API is mounted at `/post`. Send JSON request bodies with Content-Type: application/json. IDs are 24-character MongoDB ObjectIds; timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC strings. Response examples illustrate the documented structure; replace example IDs with IDs from your database before sending requests.

### Authentication flow

1. Open [login options](/login) and choose Google or GitHub. Login starts at `GET /auth/google` or `GET /auth/github` and opens in a new tab. The provider must be configured for this API origin.

2. The provider returns to `/auth/google/callback` or `/auth/github/callback`. Successful login creates a browser session and redirects to `GET /auth/me`, which returns the account ID and display name. Authentication failure returns `401` at `/auth/failure`.

3. Return to Swagger on the same origin in the same browser. Requests use the HttpOnly `connect.sid` session cookie automatically. Use `GET /users/me` to read your full public profile. Access requirements and role restrictions are described on each operation; missing authentication returns `401` and insufficient permissions return `403`.

4. End the login with `POST /auth/logout`. Authentication routes are described here while the operation list stays grouped by collection. The API navigation page and Swagger documentation are public.

Current handler limitations are stated on the affected operations. Profile deletion preserves related records and returns `409` until those references are removed.

tags.name: Posts
tags.description: Browse lost and found posts. Create and manage your own posts.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: Read, update, or delete your own profile. Administrator user listing and role changes.

tags.name: Claims
tags.description: Submit private ownership proof and review recovery requests.

tags.name: Messages
tags.description: Private conversations associated with an ownership claim.

get.summary: Search and filter lost and found posts
get.description: Returns matching posts, newest first. Available to everyone. All search parameters are optional and can be combined. If no filters are provided, all posts are returned. Pagination is not supported.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive keyword search in the post title or content. Maximum 100 characters after trimming.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter posts by category.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter posts by status.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Return posts created on or after this date (UTC). Use YYYY-MM-DD or leave empty.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Return posts created through the end of this date (UTC). Use YYYY-MM-DD or leave empty. Must not be earlier than startDate.

200.description: Matching posts, newest first. Returns an empty array if no posts match.

example.title: Found a silver ring
example.content: Found near the library entrance. Contact me with identifying details.

errors: "status" must be one of [lost, found, returned]
"category" must be one of [jewelry, household, pet, clothing, other]
"endDate" must be greater than or equal to "ref:startDate"
"startDate" must be in ISO 8601 date format

post.description: Creates a post owned by the signed-in user. Title and content must contain non-whitespace text. Category defaults to other; status defaults to lost. New posts may be lost or found, never returned.

example.title: Found a silver ring
example.content: Found near the library entrance. Contact me with identifying details.

400.description: Invalid title, content, category, or status.

value.message: Status must be lost or found

get.description: Returns a single post. Available to everyone. A malformed ID currently produces 500 rather than 400.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the post.

example.title: Found a silver ring
example.content: Found near the library entrance. Contact me with identifying details.

put.description: Owner only; administrators do not bypass ownership checks. Submit only fields to change. **Current limitation:** changes are not persisted. Supplying a recognized update field currently returns 500; an empty JSON object returns 200 with an empty body. A category-only update is also incorrectly rejected with 400.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the post.

200.description: Empty response when an empty JSON object is submitted. No changes are saved by the current handler.

400.description: Invalid post ID or update fields.

403.description: The current user does not own the post.

example.message: Forbidden: This is not your post.

delete.description: Deletes a post owned by the signed-in user. Administrators do not bypass ownership checks. Associated claims and messages are not automatically deleted.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the post.

403.description: The current user does not own the post.

example.message: Forbidden: This is not your post.

patch.description: Saves the status of a post owned by the signed-in user. Accepts lost, found, or returned. Administrators do not bypass ownership checks.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the post.

item.title: Found a silver ring
item.content: Found near the library entrance. Contact me with identifying details.

example.message: Invalid status. Must be one of: lost, found, returned

403.description: The current user does not own the post.

example.message: Forbidden: This is not your post.

get.description: Administrator only. Returns public profile fields, sorted by createdAt descending. Provider identifiers are excluded. createdAt may be absent because the User model does not currently generate timestamps.
Returns the signed-in user's public profile, using the user ID from the browser session. No ID parameter is needed. OAuth provider identifiers are excluded.

put.description: Updates only the signed-in user's name and/or email. Submit at least one field. Names are trimmed and must contain 1–100 characters; emails are trimmed, lowercased, validated, and limited to 254 characters. Omitted fields keep their current values. Roles, provider identifiers, IDs, passwords, and other unknown fields are rejected.

400.description: Invalid profile fields or an empty request body.

errors: "name" is not allowed to be empty

409.description: Another account already uses that email address.

example.message: Email address is already in use

delete.description: Deletes only the signed-in account. No request body is needed. Deletion is blocked while posts, legacy items, claims submitted or reviewed by this user, or messages sent by this user reference the account. Related records are preserved. The last administrator cannot delete their account. On success the current login session is ended, its stored session is destroyed, and the session cookie is cleared. Signing in again with a provider can create a new account.

200.description: Account deleted and current session ended.

409.description: Related records exist or the account is the last administrator.

value.message: Cannot delete account while related records exist

get.description: Users may read their own profile; administrators may read any profile. Returns public profile fields without OAuth provider identifiers.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the user profile to retrieve.

403.description: The caller is neither this user nor an administrator.

patch.description: Administrator only. Accepts user or admin. **Current limitation:** valid update requests currently fail with 500 before the target user is loaded. Role changes and the final-administrator safeguard are not currently operational.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the user whose role should change.

example.message: Role must be user or admin

get.description: Post owner or administrator only. Returns private ownership claims, newest first.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the post whose claims are requested.

example.proof: The inside of the ring has my initials engraved next to a small star.

403.description: Only the post owner or an administrator may view these claims.

post.description: Signed-in users may claim another user's post once. Proof is private and must contain 10–1,000 characters after trimming. Returned items cannot be claimed.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the post being claimed.

claim.proof: The inside of the ring has my initials engraved next to a small star.

400.description: Invalid post ID, invalid ownership proof, or returned item.

errors: "proof" length must be at least 10 characters long

403.description: You cannot claim your own post.

409.description: This user already claimed this post.

get.description: Administrator only. Returns all ownership claims, newest first, including private proof and review details.

example.proof: The inside of the ring has my initials engraved next to a small star.

get.description: Claimant, post owner, or administrator only.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the ownership claim.

example.proof: The inside of the ring has my initials engraved next to a small star.

403.description: The caller cannot access this claim.

404.description: Claim or associated post not found.

put.summary: Update proof on a pending claim
put.description: Claimant or administrator only. Only pending claims can be edited. Proof must contain 10–1,000 characters after trimming. Unknown request fields are rejected.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the claim whose proof should change.

example.proof: The inside of the ring has my initials engraved next to a small star.

400.description: Invalid claim ID, invalid ownership proof, or a claim that is no longer pending.

errors: "proof" length must be at least 10 characters long

value.message: Only pending claims can be updated

403.description: The caller is neither the claimant nor an administrator.

delete.description: Claimant or administrator only. Permanently deletes the claim rather than marking it withdrawn. Any claim status may be deleted; associated messages are not automatically removed.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the claim to delete.

403.description: The caller is neither the claimant nor an administrator.

patch.summary: Approve or reject a pending claim
patch.description: Post owner or administrator only. Only pending claims may be reviewed. Records the reviewer and review time. Approval does not change the post status. An optional review note must contain 1–1,000 characters after trimming; omit it for no note. Unknown fields are rejected.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the claim to approve or reject.

example.proof: The inside of the ring has my initials engraved next to a small star.

400.description: Invalid claim ID, invalid decision, invalid review note, or a claim that is no longer pending.

errors: "reviewNote" is not allowed to be empty

value.message: Only pending claims can be reviewed

403.description: Only the post owner or an administrator may review this claim.

404.description: Claim or associated post not found.

get.description: Only the claimant and post owner may access the conversation. Returns up to 100 messages, oldest first, without pagination.

parameters.name: claimId
parameters.description: ID of the claim associated with the conversation.

example.content: I can provide a photo of the engraving to confirm ownership.

403.description: The caller is not a conversation participant.

post.summary: Send a message about a claim
post.description: Only the claimant and post owner may send messages. Content must contain 1–5,000 characters after trimming. The sender comes from the authenticated session. Unknown request fields are rejected.

parameters.name: claimId
parameters.description: ID of the claim associated with the conversation.

example.content: I can provide a photo of the engraving to confirm ownership.

400.description: Invalid claim ID or message content.

403.description: The caller is not a conversation participant.

patch.summary: Mark a received message as read
patch.description: Only a conversation participant other than the sender may mark a message as read. Records the read timestamp and preserves it on subsequent requests. No request body is needed. A missing associated claim returns 403.

parameters.name: messageId
parameters.description: ID of the message to mark as read.

example.content: I can provide a photo of the engraving to confirm ownership.

403.description: The caller cannot mark this message as read.

value.message: Cannot mark your own message as read

delete.description: Only the original sender may permanently delete their message. Authentication is required. No request body is needed.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the message to delete.

403.description: Only the sender may delete this message.

example.message: Forbidden: this is not your message.
